title: DC-area forecast: Rain and a few storms tonight; drying out and breezy for Columbus Day
subtitle: HAPPENING NOW: Showers and a few storms continue. Temperatures in the 60s. After a possible lull near midnight, steadier rain returns in the predawn hours.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Showers and a few storms continue this evening with temperatures in the 60s. A lull is possible around midnight before another round of steadier rain overnight. There’s a very small chance of a damaging gust or two until midnight, mainly in our southern areas.

What’s next? Rain exits early Monday, with slowly increasing sun, a gusty breeze, and highs within a few degrees of 70. Sunny and warm Tuesday and Wednesday. Cooler and cloudier Thursday behind a front. Milder Friday, then a cooler weekend.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Showers and a few thunderstorms continue this evening. The risk of severe storms is remote, with the more unstable air staying well to our south. A damaging gust or two can’t be totally ruled out until midnight, mainly in our southern areas.

A lull is then possible around and after midnight before steadier rain returns into early Monday. Another quarter to half inch of rain is likely, with locally an inch or more under heavier downpours. That could cause ponding and minor flooding in poor-drainage spots. Lows are in the upper 50s to low 60s. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Columbus Day): Showers taper off early, mostly by around 8 a.m. Clouds are slow to break, but partial sunshine arrives by afternoon, making it a decent window to get out and dry off. Highs are within a few degrees of 70. Winds from the northwest blow around 10 to 15 mph, with gusts near 25 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Mostly clear as winds fade during the evening. Cool and comfortable, with lows in the 50s. Confidence: Medium-High

A look ahead

Abundant sunshine Tuesday and noticeably warmer with highs in the upper 70s to near 80. A spotty shower is possible Tuesday night with lows in the 60s. Confidence: Medium-High

As we approach mid-month, Wednesday looks to be a mostly sunny and pleasant fall day with highs in the mid-70s to near 80. A cold front comes through Wednesday night with lows in the upper 50s to near 60. Confidence: Medium

Partly sunny and turning cooler Thursday with highs in the 60s to near 70. Confidence: Medium

Today’s daily digit — 3/10: Isaias soaks our Sunday, even if rain lets up by afternoon, with gusty breezes and a rumble of thunder. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
